scope: Descriptive seed101 trajectories on the same128 fitting-training examples, seven fixed epochs. Exact weight-diagonal traces and exact factor spectra; KFAC matrices/directional quantities remain approximations. No seed CIs or causal generalization claim.

definitions.weight_traces: Sum of all six exact affine-weight-block diagonals; excludes biases. Off-diagonal blocks do not affect the trace.
definitions.gradient_norm_participation: Post hoc concentration diagnostic (sum_i norm(g_i))^2 / sum_i norm(g_i)^2, computed from stored mean and RMS; 1 means one nonzero norm,128 equal norms. Not a number of statistically independent examples.
definitions.output_rho: 10 divided by the effective rank of the projected output-space Lyapunov solution; scale invariant, not an instability threshold or optimizer LR.
definitions.timing: Recorded job elapsed excludes its own final write/commit; local dispatch includes queue/setup/wait. Diagnostics executed in separate post-training jobs.
